title: Application for tax break for housing in St. Albans, Queens
summary: The Council would approve a real property tax exemption for a housing project at Block 12334, Lot 273 in St. Albans, Queens, owned by a nonprofit housing development fund company. The exemption begins July 1, 2020 and lasts until the city and owner sign a regulatory agreement controlling how the building operates. The exemption can end early if the property is not run as required or is transferred without city approval.
